_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Codegen enforces BOTH directions: (1) every endpoints[].cli_mapping.command resolves to a cli_commands[].name here, and (2) every cli_commands[].name resolves to a command registered in cli/manifest.json (group + command) or a cli-core StandardScenarioApp built-in. Direction (2) closes the hollow-gate hole: a seed entry can no longer claim a command that no CLI actually registers.
